- `hero.film.eaip-film-field-sweeps.note`: a metaphor in a model: a knot of spins pinned against the lattice while a soft field sweeps left and right; as the pin eases the knot joins by frame 16, and held fully pinned it never does
- `hero.film.eaip-film-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eaip-film-halves-take-turns.note`: a model: two halves of a lattice start opposed, updated in turns, each feeling the other only as a growing mean field: in 60 runs they agree 100% of the time, and 0% with no link
- `hero.film.eaip-film-island-links.label`: an island is linked in
- `hero.film.eaip-film-island-links.note`: a model: a ring of 24 spins and an island of 6 set against it, Gibbs sampled at temperature 0.9; as 18 links join them, the island agrees in 3.2, then 6 of its 6 spins (300 runs)
- `hero.film.eaip-film-lattice-scan.label`: a scan finds strays
- `hero.film.eaip-film-lattice-scan.note`: a model: a lattice with 6% of its spins flipped; a scan walks down two rows a frame and behind it every spin its neighbours outvote turns: 57 high-energy sites become 0
- `hero.film.eaip-film-loud-memory-shares.label`: the strong one shares
- `hero.film.eaip-film-loud-memory-shares.note`: a Hopfield model of 120 units, one of 5 patterns stored 3 times as strongly: it catches 95% of 150 random starts; eased to equal weight it keeps 18%, the others 18 to 24 starts each
- `hero.film.eaip-film-recall-rewrites.label`: recalled and rewritten
- `hero.film.eaip-film-recall-rewrites.note`: a Hopfield model: a memory of two apart squares is recalled, nudged gently toward a linked memory of a whole ring and stored again; over 8 recalls its overlap with the ring goes 0.34 to 0.91
- `hero.film.eaip-film-two-wells-breathe.label`: two wells share
- `hero.film.eaip-film-two-wells-breathe.note`: a model: 120 walkers start in the left of two wells; the barrier lowers while a slow tilt swings left and right and fades: they end 60 and 60, the even share of detailed balance, 50%
- `hero.film.eaip-film-wide-basin.label`: into the wide basin
- `hero.film.eaip-film-wide-basin.note`: a model: 300 walkers start in a deep, narrow well; warmed gently, then cooled slowly, 74% settle in the wide basin, where the Boltzmann weights at the last temperature put 73%
- `hero.film.econd-bond-stays.label`: the memory stays
- `hero.film.econd-bond-stays.note`: an SDM pair, a tree over a sharp line, read and written back with a gentle line: the tree returns 336 of 336 bits every read while the line turns gentle, half way by read 6
- `hero.film.econd-calm-boundary.label`: a steady border
- `hero.film.econd-calm-boundary.note`: an Ising lattice at T 1.9 with its border held up settles to m = 0.95 inside (mean of 20 runs); with open edges and no border it averages m = 0.08, split into domains
- `hero.film.econd-frustration-eases.label`: frustration eases
- `hero.film.econd-frustration-eases.note`: a +-J spin glass cooled slowly: its unsatisfied bonds (bars) fall from 232 to 66; its 104 frustrated squares need at least 52, and a quench keeps 71.08 on average
- `hero.film.econd-many-colours-one.label`: many patches, few
- `hero.film.econd-many-colours-one.note`: a three-state Potts lattice at temperature 0.5 from noise: 174 same-state patches merge into 2 after 180 sweeps, and the largest state holds 55% of the sites
- `hero.film.econd-patch-heals.label`: a circle closes
- `hero.film.econd-patch-heals.note`: a disc of 256 flipped spins in an ordered Ising lattice at T 1.5 closes at a steady 2.27 sites a sweep (a straight line, R^2 0.96) and is gone after 99 sweeps
- `hero.film.econd-pendulum-sampler.label`: a sampler that swings
- `hero.film.econd-pendulum-sampler.note`: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo in a double well at T 0.45: one leapfrog swing a frame (marks); 99% of 3,000 swings are accepted, 240 cross the barrier, and the bars meet Boltzmann's law
- `hero.film.econd-replicas-exchange.label`: walkers share finds
- `hero.film.econd-replicas-exchange.note`: four walkers on one rugged energy line at T 0.12 to 1.6 swap states (dotted): the coldest reaches the deep well at frame 8; over 2,000 rounds it sits there 57% of the time, alone 0%
- `hero.film.econd-resonant-hops.label`: noise keeps time
- `hero.film.econd-resonant-hops.note`: particles in a two-valley energy landscape, rocked slowly left and right: at T 0.25 the noise lets them hop in time, 68% on the favoured side; with no rock 50%, too cold (T 0.08) 50%
- `hero.film.econd-small-settles-first.label`: small ones settle first
- `hero.film.econd-small-settles-first.note`: three Ising lattices of 5, 10 and 20 cooled to T 1.6 from noise: the median sweeps to 90% order over 24 runs are 4, 12 and 55.5, so the small ones settle first
- `hero.film.econd-two-temperatures.label`: one temperature
- `hero.film.econd-two-temperatures.note`: two Ising halves, one at T 1.26 and one at T 2.73, share a seam with the energy kept exactly; read from their demons they come to 2.19 and 2.36
- `hero.film.edeb-film-bridges-built.label`: bridges bring agreement
- `hero.film.edeb-film-bridges-built.note`: two groups of p-bits begin in opposite states and a bridge joins them each frame; here they agree from frame 3. With bridges 40 of 40 seeded runs agree, with none 0 of 40
- `hero.film.edeb-film-following-light.label`: following the light
- `hero.film.edeb-film-following-light.note`: a pocket of field moves slowly side to side along a chain of 90 p-bits; the up region follows it about 2 frames behind, one second at this pace
- `hero.film.edeb-film-free-spin.label`: a free spin
- `hero.film.edeb-film-free-spin.note`: a lattice of p-bits cools and orders, unlike neighbours falling from 0.35 to 0.04, while one spin with no bonds at all keeps flipping freely, up in 10 of 16 frames
- `hero.film.edeb-film-kinder-recall.label`: a recall comes back kinder
- `hero.film.edeb-film-kinder-recall.note`: a toy Hopfield memory: each recall of a sharp zigzag is followed by a little unlearning and a little rehearsal of a calm wave on its path; from the 8th recall it returns as the wave
- `hero.film.edeb-film-light-drifts.label`: a light drifts across
- `hero.film.edeb-film-light-drifts.note`: a soft light drifts slowly left and right across a lattice of p-bits; behind it the domains smooth, unlike neighbours falling from 0.30 to 0.13, against 0.16 with no light
- `hero.film.edeb-film-many-schedules.label`: four roads, one valley
- `hero.film.edeb-film-many-schedules.note`: four cooling schedules on one small spin glass, linear, geometric, slow start and stepped: all four reach the same floor, energy -43, the lowest of all 16,384 states
- `hero.film.edeb-film-studies-gather.label`: many samplers gather
- `hero.film.edeb-film-studies-gather.note`: 64 samplers of one ring, 17 to 1,410 sweeps long, arrive four a frame: short ones scatter, long ones gather near the exact 0.379, and their weighted pool settles at 0.381
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-leanings.label`: two leanings meet
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-leanings.note`: two camps of samplers of one ring with no field, each nudged its own way by a small field: one reads 0.26, the other -0.24, and their average reads 0.01, near the true 0
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-orders-one-law.label`: two orders, one law
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-orders-one-law.note`: one 8-spin ring sampled two ways, site by site (top) and at random sites (below): after 8,593 sweeps each histogram is within 0.014 and 0.011 of the exact law
- `hero.film.edeb-film-well-softens.label`: the well softens
- `hero.film.edeb-film-well-softens.note`: a model: walkers held in a deep narrow well, the well softening, a gentle reheat and a slow cool; the share in the wide calm basin grows from 0% to 100%. The bar is the temperature
- `hero.film.eevid-band-narrows.label`: the band narrows
- `hero.film.eevid-band-narrows.note`: a model: one p-bit with lean 0.3, sampled six times a column; its running mean goes from -0.333 to 0.250 after 576 samples as the two-standard-error band shrinks from 0.779 to 0.079
- `hero.film.eevid-barrier-lowers.label`: the barrier lowers
- `hero.film.eevid-barrier-lowers.note`: a model: 400 Metropolis walkers start in a narrow well; as the barrier to a wide basin of the same depth lowers, 76.0% come to rest on the wide side, against Boltzmann's 75.2%
- `hero.film.eevid-cooled-and-waiting.label`: one cooled, one waiting
- `hero.film.eevid-cooled-and-waiting.note`: a model: two copies of one hot Ising lattice; the cooled copy falls from -0.37 to -1.89 energy per site while the copy held at T 5.0 ends at -0.37, and the bars show the gap
- `hero.film.eevid-field-drifts.label`: a field drifts side to side
- `hero.film.eevid-field-drifts.note`: a model: a gentle field patch swings left and right over a cooling Ising lattice, once every four seconds, and the lattice's magnetisation rises from -0.04 to 0.97
- `hero.film.eevid-fragment-recalls.label`: half an address recalls
- `hero.film.eevid-fragment-recalls.note`: a model: a Kanerva SDM of 1,600 hard-locations in 256 bits holds five pictures; read from only the left or the right half of an address, 9 of 10 reads return all 256 bits
- `hero.film.eevid-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eevid-halves-take-turns.note`: a model: two halves of one Ising lattice start opposed and take turns to update, two frames each; the right half's magnetisation climbs from -1.00 to 0.93 and the halves agree
- `hero.film.eevid-pooled-estimate.label`: small runs, pooled
- `hero.film.eevid-pooled-estimate.note`: a model: fourteen small runs of one p-bit, 7 to 51 samples each, estimate its lean of 0.5; every band holds 0.5, and their inverse-variance pool narrows to 0.486, plus or minus 0.101
- `hero.film.eevid-recall-comes-back-kinder.label`: a memory comes back rounder
- `hero.film.eevid-recall-comes-back-kinder.note`: a model: a 400-unit Hopfield memory recalls a spiky star from a cue with overlap 0.405; re-stored as a rounder disc, 84 bits changed, the same cue now settles to the disc
- `hero.film.eevid-replicas-agree.label`: four replicas agree
- `hero.film.eevid-replicas-agree.note`: a model: four replicas of one 22 x 22 Ising lattice cool from T 4.0 to 1.4 under a shared field of 0.08, and the sites where all four agree rise from 16.3% to 98.8%
- `hero.film.eevid-two-roads-one-valley.label`: two roads, one valley
- `hero.film.eevid-two-roads-one-valley.note`: a model: at one temperature, Gibbs from all spins up and Metropolis from noise start at -1.63 and -0.60 energy per site; over 2,000 more sweeps they average -1.028 and -1.037
- `hero.film.ehist-band-sweeps.label`: a band sweeps the lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-band-sweeps.note`: a frozen Ising mosaic and a soft band of field drifting slowly left and right: where it passes the barriers lower and the domains join, from 66% lit to 98%
- `hero.film.ehist-fragment-finds-memory.label`: a fragment finds its memory
- `hero.film.ehist-fragment-finds-memory.note`: a Hopfield network holding four pictures, given only the lower half of one: update by update the whole house returns, overlap 0.71 to 0.99 (thumbnails, right)
- `hero.film.ehist-help-passed-along.label`: help passed along
- `hero.film.ehist-help-passed-along.note`: a model of bond percolation at p = 0.6, above the threshold 0.5: from one site, help passes along open bonds shell by shell until 444 sites join and the cluster spans the lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-pendulum-quiets.label`: the swing grows quiet
- `hero.film.ehist-pendulum-quiets.note`: forty copies of a driven swing in a warm bath: as the bath cools 16 times the cloud tightens 3.5 times, near the 3.3 that equipartition predicts
- `hero.film.ehist-quench-or-anneal.label`: quench or anneal
- `hero.film.ehist-quench-or-anneal.note`: one rugged Ising landscape, two runs: frozen at once (left) it keeps its quarrels, cooled slowly from T 3.5 (right) it reaches energy -1.97 against -1.86
- `hero.film.ehist-reciprocal-inhibition.label`: two that take turns
- `hero.film.ehist-reciprocal-inhibition.note`: two p-bit populations that inhibit each other, the switch Wolpe called reciprocal inhibition: as one is gently biased on, the other lets go, crossing at frame 10
- `hero.film.ehist-regions-in-step.label`: five rings fall into step
- `hero.film.ehist-regions-in-step.note`: a model of synchrony, five rings of Kuramoto oscillators in step inside: as the coupling between rings rises they agree as one, the order parameter (bar) going from 0.07 to 0.97
- `hero.film.ehist-seed-grows.label`: one seed, a whole lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-seed-grows.note`: an Ising lattice at T 1.2 under a gentle field: one small lit seed grows by Metropolis flips until agreement fills the grid, from 1.0% lit to 99.9%
- `hero.film.ehist-two-sides-meet.label`: two sides meet
- `hero.film.ehist-two-sides-meet.note`: two coupled Ising layers that start opposite, one lit and one dark: warmed, then cooled slowly, they come to agree on 100% of their sites (the bridge between them)
- `hero.film.ehist-walk-light.label`: a narrow well, a wide basin
- `hero.film.ehist-walk-light.note`: a model, not a mechanism: walkers held in a narrow well are warmed (thermometer, 0 to 10) and cooled slowly, and 75% settle in the wider, lower basin
- `hero.film.eight-queens.label`: eight queens
- `hero.film.eight-queens.note`: queens moved by the Metropolis rule as the temperature falls; a line joins each pair that attack, until none do
- `hero.film.emech-barrier-lowers.label`: the barrier lowers
- `hero.film.emech-barrier-lowers.note`: 240 Metropolis walkers in a double well at T 0.3; as the barrier lowers from 2.2 to 0.3 both sides share them, 367 crossings one way and 348 back in the last frame
- `hero.film.emech-eight-steps.label`: eight steps to calm
- `hero.film.emech-eight-steps.note`: simulated annealing of a 12-city tour on an eight-step cooling staircase: a tangle of 22 crossings opens into one calm loop, length 445 down to 157, the best found
- `hero.film.emech-every-give.label`: every give, a take
- `hero.film.emech-every-give.note`: a six-state Markov chain relaxes to its Boltzmann distribution: the net flow on every edge falls from 0.151 to 0.002, detailed balance, each give matched by a take
- `hero.film.emech-kinder-recall.label`: the ring comes back whole
- `hero.film.emech-kinder-recall.note`: a Hopfield memory of a broken ring is recalled, held under a gentle field while its 42-cell gap fills, and written back; the old cue now recalls the whole ring
- `hero.film.emech-quench.label`: order arriving
- `hero.film.emech-quench.note`: a 32 x 24 Ising lattice quenched to T 1.6: Gibbs sweeps grow its domains until order arrives, energy per spin from 0.03 to -1.92, where the ground state is -2
- `hero.film.emech-room-for-two.label`: room for two
- `hero.film.emech-room-for-two.note`: a Hopfield net with room for 144 active units holds a diamond; a second input circling it takes room, the picture keeps its centre, 90 of 144 units, then returns whole
- `hero.film.emech-sweeping-field.label`: a field drifts
- `hero.film.emech-sweeping-field.note`: an Ising lattice cools from T 3.2 to 1.5 while a soft field drifts left and right once every 4 seconds; its spins come to agree, magnetisation 0.26 to 0.99
- `hero.film.emech-two-choirs.label`: two choirs, one beat
- `hero.film.emech-two-choirs.note`: two Kuramoto networks of 16 oscillators fall into step inside, then a bond between them grows and both lock to one beat, order 0.999 and a steady phase gap
- `hero.film.emech-two-halves.label`: two halves agree
- `hero.film.emech-two-halves.note`: two Ising patches, each spin coupled to its twin across the gap, take turns to update as they cool: the halves agree on 35% of spins, then on 98%
- `hero.film.emech-wide-basin.label`: a wider basin
- `hero.film.emech-wide-basin.note`: 300 walkers start in a deep narrow well; warmed to T 0.34 and cooled slowly, 262 of them settle in the wide, deeper basin. a picture of annealing, a model only
- `hero.film.eprac-calm-basin.label`: many starts, few basins
- `hero.film.eprac-calm-basin.note`: a Hopfield memory of 100 units holds three shapes; six random starts cool by Gibbs sweeps into them; of 200 random starts, 98.5% end within overlap 0.9 of a stored shape or its mirror
- `hero.film.eprac-field-sweeps.label`: a band drifts across
- `hero.film.eprac-field-sweeps.note`: a gentle field band drifts left and right across a cool Ising lattice, four seconds a swing: an island of 480 opposite spins is gone by frame 22; with no band 202 remain
- `hero.film.eprac-gentle-schedule.label`: a gentle cooling
- `hero.film.eprac-gentle-schedule.note`: a 24 x 24 Ising lattice cooled by Metropolis sweeps in 20 small steps from temperature 3 to 1: the energy per spin falls from -0.847 to -2 (dots), never more than 0.278 a step
- `hero.film.eprac-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eprac-halves-take-turns.note`: two-block Gibbs sampling on a lattice with a ring-shaped field: the left half samples for one second, then the right half, in turn; agreement with the ring rises from 0.62 to 1.00
- `hero.film.eprac-ladder-cools.label`: the ladder cools
- `hero.film.eprac-ladder-cools.note`: 300 walkers on an energy ladder of rungs 0 to 10 take Metropolis steps as the temperature falls from 6 to 0.6: the mean rung falls from 10 to 0.27, against 0.23 from exp(-E/T) (ticks)
- `hero.film.eprac-practice-learns.label`: practice
- `hero.film.eprac-practice-learns.note`: a Boltzmann machine of 12 p-bits practises three patterns by the exact likelihood gradient: their share of its probability rises from 0.07% to 95.7% in 20 rounds; left, six samples
- `hero.film.eprac-scan-finds-strays.label`: a scan for strays
- `hero.film.eprac-scan-finds-strays.note`: a scan line checks an Ising lattice row by row and turns every spin its neighbours pull the other way: 45 strays at the start, 48 turns, energy per spin from -1.511 to -2
- `hero.film.eprac-two-agree.label`: two populations agree
- `hero.film.eprac-two-agree.note`: two p-bit populations, the left held by its own field, the right coupled to it unit by unit as the bath cools: their overlap q rises from -0.43 to 0.99; dual attention as a picture
- `hero.film.eprac-two-roads.label`: two roads to calm
- `hero.film.eprac-two-roads.note`: two 16 x 16 Ising lattices, 100 Metropolis sweeps each: one holds warm then cools, one cools steadily; both drawn runs reach -2 per spin, and over 32 runs -1.92 and -1.96
- `hero.film.eprac-two-sessions.label`: two sessions and a pause
- `hero.film.eprac-two-sessions.note`: an island of 308 opposite spins: a warm session melts it to 118, a pause at T = 0 rests it at 94, a second session settles it to 0; a closed session, as a metaphor only
- `hero.film.eprot-film-barrier-lowers.label`: the wall comes down
- `hero.film.eprot-film-barrier-lowers.note`: 60 walkers in a deep narrow well; the wall beside it is lowered from 1.6 to 0 and they flow into the wide basin: 37 of 60 there at the end, where Boltzmann gives 70%
- `hero.film.eprot-film-body-scan.label`: a slow scan
- `hero.film.eprot-film-body-scan.note`: a line passes down a settled lattice, framing each stray site with three or four unhappy bonds, and the rows behind it settle again: 5 found, 0 left, unhappy bonds 18 to 0
- `hero.film.eprot-film-chain-back.label`: back to the first
- `hero.film.eprot-film-chain-back.note`: a Kanerva SDM holds links from each shape to the one before; read from the last shape with 20% of its bits wrong, four reads walk back to the first, 99% right
- `hero.film.eprot-film-eight-stages.label`: cooled in eight steps
- `hero.film.eprot-film-eight-stages.note`: 960 spins frozen in 9 patches, warmed a little, then cooled in eight steps from T 2.1 to 0.6: the patches merge into one and the unhappy bonds fall from 334 to 0
- `hero.film.eprot-film-give-and-take.label`: give and take
- `hero.film.eprot-film-give-and-take.note`: 48 walkers start crowded in the first of four wells: 42 cross the first gap right and 21 back at first; at equilibrium each gap's flows match, 208 and 206, 216 and 212, 123 and 121
- `hero.film.eprot-film-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eprot-film-halves-take-turns.note`: block Gibbs sampling while cooling from T 2.6 to 1.0: the left half samples while the right holds, then they swap; the unhappy bonds fall from 864 to 54 of 1,760
- `hero.film.eprot-film-rocking-well.label`: the well rocks
- `hero.film.eprot-film-rocking-well.note`: 40 walkers start in the left of two wells; the landscape tilts gently left and right every 4 s and they spread to both: 282 crossings over 20 runs, against 119 with no tilt
- `hero.film.eprot-film-three-prongs.label`: three in turn
- `hero.film.eprot-film-three-prongs.note`: three coupled lattices, a field in the first only, settled one after another: first to last, the last copies its disc 85% of the way over 40 runs; last to first, 51%
- `hero.film.eprot-film-two-populations.label`: two groups agree
- `hero.film.eprot-film-two-populations.note`: two groups of 36 p-bits lean opposite ways, means 0.8 and -0.9; as their coupling grows from 0 to 2.4 and the leanings fade, they settle on one answer, -1.0 and -1.0
- `hero.film.eprot-film-warm-zone.label`: a warm band passes
- `hero.film.eprot-film-warm-zone.note`: a warm band with a small pull toward the majority drifts across a frozen spin lattice and back: 20 of 20 runs end with no unhappy bond, against 7 of 20 left cold
- `hero.film.esci-barrier-lowers.label`: the barrier lowers
- `hero.film.esci-barrier-lowers.note`: 300 walkers at T 0.25 in a double well whose barrier falls from 1.4 to 0.2: in 600 Metropolis steps the share that crosses the top rises from 1% to 66%
- `hero.film.esci-chain-of-reads.label`: a chain of reads
- `hero.film.esci-chain-of-reads.note`: a Kanerva SDM holds five pictures in a ring, each written at the address of the one before; read from 70 bits off, the first read is exact and each read walks to the next
- `hero.film.esci-detailed-balance.label`: every give, a take
- `hero.film.esci-detailed-balance.note`: 3,000 Metropolis walkers start on the top of three energy levels; soon the flows each way between levels match within 8%, and 67% rest on the lowest, as Boltzmann says
- `hero.film.esci-eight-step-cooling.label`: eight steps, then a scan
- `hero.film.esci-eight-step-cooling.note`: an Ising lattice cooled in eight steps keeps 14 stray high-energy spins; a scan row by row turns each one until 0 are left (eight phases and a body scan, as a metaphor)
- `hero.film.esci-field-sweeps-lattice.label`: a field sweeps the lattice
- `hero.film.esci-field-sweeps-lattice.note`: an Ising lattice cooled from T 3.0 to 1.0 while a weak field band drifts slowly left and right settles with no broken bonds; with no field, 2.8% stay broken
- `hero.film.esci-reread-and-rewrite.label`: reread and rewrite
- `hero.film.esci-reread-and-rewrite.note`: a Kanerva SDM recalls a star from 50 bits off; a ring is then written at the star's own address once a frame, and from the 4th write that address reads back the ring (a model)
- `hero.film.esci-strong-memory-shares.label`: a strong memory makes room
- `hero.film.esci-strong-memory-shares.note`: a hopfield network holds 5 patterns, one stored 3 times as strongly; as its strength eases to 1, its share of 120 random starts falls from 95% to 14% and the other basins open
- `hero.film.esci-two-crowds-agree.label`: two crowds agree
- `hero.film.esci-two-crowds-agree.note`: two Ising patches start opposed, each spin coupled to its partner, updated in turns, left then right, as T cools from 2.6 to 1.5: their spins go from 34% to 99% in agreement
- `hero.film.esci-unlearning-clears.label`: unlearning clears the way
- `hero.film.esci-unlearning-clears.note`: a hopfield network of 100 units holds 12 patterns; unlearning from noise (Hopfield, Feinstein, Palmer 1983) lifts the random starts that reach a stored one from 19% to 58%
- `hero.film.esci-warm-then-cool.label`: warm, then cool slowly
- `hero.film.esci-warm-then-cool.note`: 200 Metropolis walkers held in a narrow energy well are warmed to T 0.38, then cooled slowly: 75% settle in the wider, lower basin (annealing, drawn as a metaphor)
- `hero.film.evar-film-cooling-scale.label`: a scale of warmth
- `hero.film.evar-film-cooling-scale.note`: a 0 to 10 scale drawn as temperature, as the 0 to 10 rating of emdr might be pictured: as it falls, a stored ripple settles out of gibbs noise, overlap 0.14 to 1.00
- `hero.film.evar-film-drifting-light.label`: a drifting warm light
- `hero.film.evar-film-drifting-light.note`: a warm band sweeps an ising lattice left and right every 4 seconds while the pin on a knot of down spins lowers: the knot is gone by frame 12. a picture, not a therapy
- `hero.film.evar-film-gentle-not-sudden.label`: gentle, not sudden
- `hero.film.evar-film-gentle-not-sudden.note`: one start, two schedules: held cold at once, a random-field ising lattice freezes (left); cooled slowly from T 3.0 it finds lower energy, -1.89 against -1.66 a site
- `hero.film.evar-film-halves-take-turns.label`: two banks, one bridge
- `hero.film.evar-film-halves-take-turns.note`: a bridge stored as one hopfield memory, settled by its left and right halves in turn, two frames each: both banks rise to overlap 1.00 and meet in one picture
- `hero.film.evar-film-narrow-well-softens.label`: a narrow well softens
- `hero.film.evar-film-narrow-well-softens.note`: a hopfield memory stored three times as strongly is a deep narrow well: 90% of 200 random starts fall in. eased to equal weight, its share falls to 12%
- `hero.film.evar-film-one-schedule-many.label`: one schedule, many settle
- `hero.film.evar-film-one-schedule-many.note`: eighteen small ising lattices cooled by one shared schedule, T 3.5 to 0.5: their mean magnetisation rises from 0.27 to 1.00 and all 18 settle together
- `hero.film.evar-film-ring-in-step.label`: needles in step
- `hero.film.evar-film-ring-in-step.note`: twenty-four needles, a mean-field xy model cooled by metropolis steps from T 2.0: their order r rises from 0.21 to 0.99 as they turn to one shared direction
- `hero.film.evar-film-search-and-settle.label`: found and settled
- `hero.film.evar-film-search-and-settle.note`: five islands of opposite spin in a settled ising lattice, found largest first by a moving window and settled there by gibbs sweeps: unhappy bonds fall from 234 to 0
- `hero.film.evar-film-signal-arrives.label`: a signal arrives whole
- `hero.film.evar-film-signal-arrives.note`: a sun of 576 lights sent with 185 flipped arrives at overlap 0.36 (left); hopfield recall by the projection rule, a few lights a frame, restores it to 1.00 (right)
- `hero.film.evar-film-wings-in-turn.label`: two wings, in turn
- `hero.film.evar-film-wings-in-turn.note`: two wing-shaped spin populations, each a hopfield memory of one wing, joined cell to mirror cell and updated in turn: mirror agreement rises from 0.62 to 1.00 as they cool
- `hero.film.fhops-film-cloud-splits.label`: a cloud splits
- `hero.film.fhops-film-cloud-splits.note`: a small SDM, 200 reads that all start 64 bits off their words, one hop a frame: the cloud of distances splits, 97 reads reach their word and 102 drift out past 64 bits
- `hero.film.fhops-film-graded-weights.label`: two weight rules
- `hero.film.fhops-film-graded-weights.note`: our trained SDM model, one read at 16 real positions: the soft cut-off it was trained with spreads the read over 59.5 locations on average, the graded rule on the same scores over 23.6
- `hero.film.fhops-film-hop-moves-address.label`: each hop moves the address
- `hero.film.fhops-film-hop-moves-address.note`: our trained SDM model on real text: how many of a hop's 32 woken locations the earlier reads moved, median 10 at hop 2, 1 at hop 3 and 32 at hop 4
- `hero.film.fhops-film-read-becomes-address.label`: the read becomes the address
- `hero.film.fhops-film-read-becomes-address.note`: an SDM read copied up as the next address, the wrong bits lit: from 26 bits off they fall to 7, then 0; from 52 bits off they grow to 64 and the word is lost
- `hero.film.fhops-film-woken-gather.label`: the woken gather
- `hero.film.fhops-film-woken-gather.note`: hard-locations placed by their distance from one stored word, the ones each read wakes lit: from 16 to 72 bits off all 40 gather inside its circle, from 88 and 104 most stay outside
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-chain-decode.label`: a chain read back
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-chain-decode.note`: ENFOLDS stored as one vector, each letter bound to a randomly permuted next letter; unbinding from E reads it back letter by letter. With no permutation the chain reads ENFNFNF
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-noise-floor.label`: the noise floor sinks
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-noise-floor.note`: a vector convolved with its involution as its width n doubles from 16 to 2048: the spike at zero stays near 1 while the noise around it sinks from 0.18 to 0.022, as 1/sqrt(n)
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-places-gather.label`: places in one vector
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-places-gather.note`: eleven places on a line bundled one by one into a single 1,024-number vector of fractional powers: its similarity curve grows a bump at every place it holds, at most 0.29 between them
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-powers.label`: powers of a vector
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-powers.note`: a random vector bound to itself 16 times (top) runs to one sine, 99.7% of its power in one frequency, its norm to about 86,500; a unitary vector (below) keeps norm 1 and a flat spectrum
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-read-wave.label`: a read as the trace fills
- `hero.film.fhrr-film-read-wave.note`: one filler (top) and the vector unbound for it (below) as 16 role-filler pairs join one trace of 256 numbers: the cosine falls from 0.69 to 0.18, yet cleanup among 60 fillers still picks it
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-grow-k.label`: the staircase grows
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-grow-k.note`: the k best SDM locations of one position in sorted coordinates, k from 1 to 64, untrained left, trained right: always a staircase; at k 32 it spans 13 by 8, then 10 by 4
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-hash-fill.label`: a hash table fills
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-hash-fill.note`: 720 tokens of our text stream their bigrams into a 1,024-row hash table as our n-gram store addresses them: 634 distinct bigrams on 482 rows, Poisson says 472.7; 127 rows shared
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-merge.label`: one address becomes another
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-merge.note`: a straight line between two real addresses of our trained model in 18 steps: the woken set keeps 22 of the first 32, then fewer, then for 7 steps holds neither end's cells
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-search.label`: the exact search
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-search.note`: a small product-key store of our model's class, 256 locations, k 4: score each half, keep its best 8, cross them, keep the best 8 cells; brute force agrees, and below the cut weights fall to 0.28
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-sweep.label`: an address walks a passage
- `hero.film.fkeys-film-sweep.note`: 20 positions of real text in our trained model, the 32 locations each address wakes; the bar counts those shared with the token before: none at 13 steps, at most 30
- `hero.film.flock.label`: a flock
- `hero.film.flock.note`: 48 birds, each steering by its neighbours alone: separation, alignment, cohesion
- `hero.film.floop-film-ageing.label`: a memory ages
- `hero.film.floop-film-ageing.note`: a letter enfolded, then 60 newer facts written over it in a vector that fades by 0.97 a write: the raw read dissolves at once, and cleanup holds until age 22
- `hero.film.floop-film-foldback.label`: fold-back
- `hero.film.floop-film-foldback.note`: each sampled verdict is enfolded again, so the store comes to agree with itself: here A, behind 2 to 3, takes it; in 1,000 such runs the first leader won 792
- `hero.film.floop-film-generate.label`: unfold, roll back, unfold
- `hero.film.floop-film-generate.note`: a phrase enfolded as 13 facts in one 1,024-number vector, read back a letter a time: each read letter rolls into the 3-letter address that reads the next
- `hero.film.floop-film-loop-orbit.label`: the loop
- `hero.film.floop-film-loop-orbit.note`: one cycle three times round: address, the Complicate, unbind, cleanup, fold-back, roll back; the middle is the live 256-bit vector, the read 63% to 68% right
- `hero.film.floop-film-overload.label`: too many facts
- `hero.film.floop-film-overload.note`: one phrase regenerated from a 512-number vector holding more and more other facts: right to its end up to 45 facts, and wrong from the first letter at 143
- `hero.film.forty-hz-slow.label`: the 40 Hz light, slowed
- `hero.film.forty-hz-slow.note`: the site's 40 Hz light drawn 80 times slower: lit 12.5 ms, dark 12.5 ms, its square wave traced beside the lamp
- `hero.film.fours-cleanup-by-hop.label`: the cleanup, hop by hop
- `hero.film.fours-cleanup-by-hop.note`: our model's cleanup (its final norm and token table) taken after 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 hops for four real contexts: the right next token rises, 'most' from rank 95,683 to rank 1
- `hero.film.fours-cutoff-softness.label`: how soft the cut-off is
- `hero.film.fours-cutoff-softness.note`: one real read's 64 candidate scores span just 0.49, so as the softness runs from 0.025 to 3.3 the weights go from a sharp cut at 32 to all near one half; the trained 0.25 gives 0.74 to 0.28
- `hero.film.fours-read-sizes.label`: how much a read adds
- `hero.film.fours-read-sizes.note`: the size of our model's working vector (top) and of each of its 4 reads, token by token along a real passage: on average a read adds 4.0 to 5.2% of the working vector's size
- `hero.film.fours-roll-back.label`: the token rolls back
- `hero.film.fours-roll-back.note`: our model writes from 'A memory settles into the pattern it': each chosen token rolls back into the 13 feature rows and the four tables wake new cells; greedy, from its 11th token it repeats
- `hero.film.fours-store-fills.label`: the tables in use
- `hero.film.fours-store-fills.note`: the four hop tables while our model reads 2,560 tokens of our science page: a location stays lit once woken, and only 1,733, 1,888, 1,413 and 1,648 of 65,536 ever wake
- `hero.film.fread-bundle-until-misread.label`: until a misread
- `hero.film.fread-bundle-until-misread.note`: one fact unbound from bundles of 1 to 64 facts in 128 dimensions: its bar sinks to the best of 47 wrong rows (dashed); a wrong row first wins at 16 facts, and from 32 on always
- `hero.film.fread-cleanup-temperature.label`: cleanup at a temperature
- `hero.film.fread-cleanup-temperature.note`: cleanup as a Boltzmann choice, p(row) as exp(cos/T) over 24 codebook rows: as T falls from 0.4 to 0.02 the spread of 4.56 bits collapses onto the stored row, p from 0.07 to 1
- `hero.film.fread-star-drifts-out.label`: the star drifts out
- `hero.film.fread-star-drifts-out.note`: the address that unbinds a bundle of 3 is corrupted bit by bit: the stored row drifts out from cos 0.551 into the ring of 299 wrong ones, lost once 410 of 1,024 bits are flipped
- `hero.film.fread-unbind-clean-unbind.label`: unbind, clean, unbind
- `hero.film.fread-unbind-clean-unbind.note`: a record inside a record (256 dimensions) unbound twice: with no cleanup between (top) the filler is lost from 6 outer facts on; cleaned against 16 records between (bottom) it holds to 32
- `hero.film.fread-unfold-a-word.label`: unfold a word
- `hero.film.fread-unfold-a-word.note`: one 1,024-dimension Complicate holds SETTLE, each letter bound to its place; unbinding each place and cleaning up against 26 letters spells it back: right at cos 0.378 or more
- `hero.film.frun-film-buckets.label`: what a position wakes
- `hero.film.frun-film-buckets.note`: eight rows, the 8 SDM locations a position wakes, and a mark wherever an earlier position wrote into one: this window's 2,048 run-time writes land in only 828 of 4,096 buckets
- `hero.film.frun-film-causal.label`: never the future
- `hero.film.frun-film-causal.note`: one token changed at position p, p sweeping the window: every run-time read before p moves by exactly 0, every read from p on moves; the SDM write only ever reaches forward
- `hero.film.frun-film-phrase-found.label`: a phrase found again
- `hero.film.frun-film-phrase-found.note`: the run-time read of each position over every earlier one, as bars: when a phrase comes back, 4 of its 7 tokens read their first copy 112 tokens back, far past the 8 back tokens of the SDM address
- `hero.film.frun-film-shuffle.label`: real against shuffled
- `hero.film.frun-film-shuffle.note`: where the raw run-time read names the next token first (a square) or in its top 100 (a dot), across 255 positions: 19 and 85 with the real SDM write, 8 and 48 with the written vectors shuffled
- `hero.film.frun-film-triangle.label`: the read triangle grows
- `hero.film.frun-film-triangle.note`: our run-time write over 150 positions of a real window: as each arrives, it reads the SDM locations earlier ones wrote; 266 blocks light, and above the diagonal stays exactly 0
- `hero.film.fsdm-critical-shrinks.label`: the critical distance moves
- `hero.film.fsdm-critical-shrinks.note`: a real SDM filled from 76 to 166 words: its mean one-read map rises, and the critical-distance where it crosses the diagonal moves in from 340 to 61 bits
- `hero.film.fsdm-hamming-ball.label`: a circle in bits
- `hero.film.fsdm-hamming-ball.note`: an SDM's access circle on 2,048 addresses of 11 bits in Gray code, neighbours one bit apart: at activation-radius 4 it holds 562 of them, lit up to 37 cells away
- `hero.film.fsdm-lesion.label`: hard locations destroyed
- `hero.film.fsdm-lesion.note`: an SDM's hard-locations destroyed 5% a frame from 2,400: an A read from 120 bits off comes back whole until 70% are gone, from 13 survivors; at 75% it is 35 bits wrong
- `hero.film.fsdm-letter-drift.label`: a read address drifts
- `hero.film.fsdm-letter-drift.note`: a stored A read from 30 more of its 1,000 bits off each frame: one read (middle) is 11 bits wrong by 60; the iterated-reads (right) stay exact up to 210, then lose it
- `hero.film.fsdm-radius-sweep.label`: the activation radius
- `hero.film.fsdm-radius-sweep.note`: a real SDM read from 200 bits off as the activation-radius widens from 444 to 492: woken hard-locations climb from 1 to 1,265, and a read is best at 465, 60 bits wrong
- `hero.film.ftrain-loss-falls.label`: the loss falls
- `hero.film.ftrain-loss-falls.note`: our SDM model's training loss, logged every 100 steps of a 60M-token run at width 768, falls from 6.85 to 5.06 nats while the learning rate cools from 0.003 to 0.0003
- `hero.film.ftrain-lr-sweep.label`: four learning rates
- `hero.film.ftrain-lr-sweep.note`: four peak learning rates for our SDM model, 0.001 to 0.01: each cosine schedule above, its loss minus the 0.003 run's below; 0.001 ends 0.139 nats behind, 0.01 0.075 ahead
- `hero.film.ftrain-rows-used.label`: locations a store uses
- `hero.film.ftrain-rows-used.note`: the share of each store's locations that test text wakes in our trained SDM: 3 to 4% at k 16, 4 to 6% at k 32, 7 to 16% at k 64; 15 to 22% of 16,384 locations, 1 to 2% of 262,144
- `hero.film.ftrain-three-arms.label`: reads, none, dense
- `hero.film.ftrain-three-arms.note`: three of our models trained on 60M tokens: trained SDM reads, no reads, a small dense layer; the reads track no reads to the end (1.609 against 1.607 bits per byte), dense 1.518
- `hero.film.ftrain-wider-lower.label`: wider is lower
- `hero.film.ftrain-wider-lower.note`: our SDM model at four widths over 60M tokens, each line its quick eval minus width 256's, thicker for wider; wider stays lower all run, TEST 1.607, 1.589, 1.578 and 1.560 bits per byte
- `hero.film.fwrite-bundle-stiffens.label`: the bundle stiffens
- `hero.film.fwrite-bundle-stiffens.note`: twenty 96-bit hypervectors enfolded one a frame into a counter strip: the counters grow, and each new fact flips fewer bits of the signed Complicate: 22 at the second, 8 at the twentieth
- `hero.film.fwrite-delta-sweeps.label`: the delta rule
- `hero.film.fwrite-delta-sweeps.note`: writing 24 facts with correlated keys into a linear memory: the one-shot sum reads back 29.9% of bits wrong (dashed); the delta rule falls sweep by sweep to none wrong at sweep 8
- `hero.film.fwrite-plaid-builds.label`: a plaid turns to noise
- `hero.film.fwrite-plaid-builds.note`: a linear memory written one outer product v a^T a frame: the first fact is a clean plaid and the sum turns to noise, yet the first fact still reads back 21 of its 22 bits (the bar)
- `hero.film.fwrite-store-fills.label`: the store fills
- `hero.film.fwrite-store-fills.note`: a real SDM of 480 hard-locations in 64 bits written three words a frame: each location lights at its first write; after 60 words 84.2% have one, against 83.9% from 1 - (1 - p)^T (tick)
- `hero.film.fwrite-willshaw-fills.label`: a Willshaw memory fills
- `hero.film.fwrite-willshaw-fills.note`: a Willshaw memory takes sparse pairs, each write setting bits with a logical or: after 120 pairs 77.6% of the matrix is set, as 1 - (1 - a^2)^M says (tick), and a read gives 6.8 false bits
- `hero.film.hebb-learns.label`: cells that fire together
- `hero.film.hebb-learns.note`: the Hebb rule builds a weight matrix one pattern at a time; then the first pattern with three bits wrong is recalled whole
- `hero.film.hopfield-basins.label`: two basins
- `hero.film.hopfield-basins.note`: a Hopfield net storing a ring and a plus: six mixed probes each fall into the memory they started nearer
- `hero.film.hopfield-complete.label`: a memory completes a letter
- `hero.film.hopfield-complete.note`: a net storing four letters is shown an S with its lower half erased, and fills it in
- `hero.film.hopfield.label`: a Hopfield recall
- `hero.film.hopfield.note`: a noisy ring falls back into the ring the net stored
- `hero.film.horse.label`: HORSE
- `hero.film.horse.note`: a horse at the gallop: Muybridge, 1878, public domain
- `hero.film.ising-critical.label`: the critical point
- `hero.film.ising-critical.note`: an Ising field at T 2.27, where order and disorder balance: clusters of every size
- `hero.film.isted-drawn.label`: ISTED?
- `hero.film.isted-drawn.note`: a rider pedalling over a jump, drawn in code
- `hero.film.kfold-film-coming-home.label`: coming home
- `hero.film.kfold-film-coming-home.note`: iterated reads of a crowded SDM from 32 start distances, four hops a turn; between turns the word's verdict is folded back twice more, and more reads come home: 1, 12, 19 then 26 of 32
- `hero.film.kfold-film-handshake-turns.label`: the handshake holds
- `hero.film.kfold-film-handshake-turns.note`: a vector's phase dials turn as its fractional power grows (top); bound to a second vector every angle adds (middle); unbinding by the first gives the second back unmoved (bottom)
- `hero.film.kfold-film-key-turns.label`: the key turns
- `hero.film.kfold-film-key-turns.note`: one 512-number vector holds two half rings under two keys; the reading key turns from one key to the other and the unfolded drawing slides from half to half, whole in between
- `hero.film.kfold-film-planks.label`: a bridge, plank by plank
- `hero.film.kfold-film-planks.note`: pairs bound and added one a frame into a 1,024-number bridge vector (top); each bar is a pair carried across, its cosine falling from 1.00 to 0.19 while the cleanup names all 16 partners
- `hero.film.kfold-film-remembered.label`: being remembered
- `hero.film.kfold-film-remembered.note`: our model's run-time write over a refrain sung three times (seeded weights): each later position's read reaches back to the earlier copies, and 8 reads name the token that followed
- `hero.film.kmany-film-chord-circle.label`: a chord rounds out
- `hero.film.kmany-film-chord-circle.note`: hypervectors join a chord one a frame; its cosine to every member stays alike (0.20 to 0.30 with 16, near 1/sqrt(16)) and strangers stay under 0.05: the polygon rounds into a circle
- `hero.film.kmany-film-handed-on.label`: handed on kindly
- `hero.film.kmany-film-handed-on.note`: a picture handed on 15 times, each hand-off flipping 10% of its bits: read back through an SDM at every hand it arrives whole; copied plainly it arrives with 133 of 256 bits wrong
- `hero.film.kmany-film-shared-part.label`: two memories, one middle
- `hero.film.kmany-film-shared-part.note`: a Hopfield net holding two memories that share their middle: from a noisy start on one side only (157 bits wrong) each comes back whole in 2 sweeps, the shared middle lit in both
- `hero.film.kmany-film-strangers.label`: strangers in step
- `hero.film.kmany-film-strangers.note`: two lattices of p-bits, each site coupled to its partner as the coupling grows from 0 to 2.5: they come into step (agreement 0.53 to 0.99) and their mutual information rises to 0.94 bits
- `hero.film.kmany-film-two-minds.label`: two minds agree
- `hero.film.kmany-film-two-minds.note`: two SDMs with different random hard-locations read the same noisy address (66, then 78 bits wrong) by iterated-reads: their answers come into agreement on the stored picture
- `hero.film.kqua-film-anneal-common-ground.label`: finding the common ground
- `hero.film.kqua-film-anneal-common-ground.note`: quantum annealing of 6 spins, every one of 64 arrangements held at once (the squares), then the field gives way: 98% of the probability gathers where every spin agrees, all up 55%, all down 43%
- `hero.film.kqua-film-gift-arrives.label`: a gift arrives whole
- `hero.film.kqua-film-gift-arrives.note`: one excitation passed along a chain of 9 qubits whose couplings are sqrt(k(N-k)): it spreads, then gathers at the far end with probability 1.0000
- `hero.film.kqua-film-many-lift-one.label`: many lift one
- `hero.film.kqua-film-many-lift-one.note`: Grover's search over 32 states: each round flips the marked amplitude, then all reflect about their mean; the marked one rises to probability 0.999
- `hero.film.kqua-film-share-equally.label`: sharing equally
- `hero.film.kqua-film-share-equally.note`: two qubits pass one excitation back and forth; their entanglement (the bridge) is greatest, 1.00, exactly when each holds it with probability 0.50
- `hero.film.kqua-film-turn-to-agree.label`: turning to agree
- `hero.film.kqua-film-turn-to-agree.note`: a Bell pair, one analyser turning from 90 to 0 degrees: 24 shots a frame agree 0 of 24 at first, 24 of 24 at last; the probability they agree is cos^2 of the angle
- `hero.film.krec-film-home.label`: home
- `hero.film.krec-film-home.note`: the word home stored with four others in an SDM of 4,000 hard-locations, read from four random thirds of it: each comes home, as do 16 of 20 such thirds
- `hero.film.krec-film-slip-forgiven.label`: a slip forgiven
- `hero.film.krec-film-slip-forgiven.note`: our model with one of its last 8 tokens slipped: a slip in the newest token keeps 8.9 of 32 woken locations, one 7 back 24.1; the next token holds 9.5% and 86.5% of the time
- `hero.film.krec-film-spiral.label`: winding home
- `hero.film.krec-film-spiral.note`: iterated-reads of an SDM from 16 start distances, each read a quarter turn whose radius is the distance from the stored word: every start up to 72 bits away winds home
- `hero.film.krec-film-stray-drifts.label`: an address strays
- `hero.film.krec-film-stray-drifts.note`: our model's first hop while a real address strays further: the true 32 woken locations kept (right) fall from 32 to 0, the read's cosine to the true read (the arc) only to 0.78
- `hero.film.krec-film-wedge-grows.label`: the wedge it forgives
- `hero.film.krec-film-wedge-grows.note`: a flower stored with five other pictures in an SDM; a wedge of its address set at random widens to 120 degrees, the widest at which 12 of 12 reads still come home
- `hero.film.kset-fireflies.label`: fireflies fall into step
- `hero.film.kset-fireflies.note`: 144 oscillators in a lattice network, each coupled to its neighbours (Kuramoto), lit when near the top of its cycle: they twinkle at random, then flash together as the order r rises from 0.03 to 1.00
- `hero.film.kset-gentlest-state.label`: the gentlest state
- `hero.film.kset-gentlest-state.note`: a 5 x 5 lattice of plus and minus bonds anneals as T falls: broken bonds drop from 20 to 5, the fewest any of its 33,554,432 arrangements allows (counted exactly)
- `hero.film.kset-give-and-take.label`: every give meets a take
- `hero.film.kset-give-and-take.note`: probability poured into one corner of 16 states spreads by Metropolis moves; the net flow on every edge falls from 0.25 to 0.0002 as the populations reach the Boltzmann law
- `hero.film.kset-pairs-reconcile.label`: opposed pairs reconcile
- `hero.film.kset-pairs-reconcile.note`: eight pairs of p-bits begin opposed; one Gibbs sweep a frame as T falls from 3 to 0.3 raises the exact probability a pair agrees from 66% to 99.9%, and every pair ends joined
- `hero.film.kset-ring-gathers.label`: a ring gathers
- `hero.film.kset-ring-gathers.note`: 20 Kuramoto oscillators with different paces, each pulled toward the mean of the network, as dots round a circle: they gather into one arc as the arrow of the mean r grows from 0.26 to 0.94
- `hero.film.magnet-flip.label`: a magnet flips
- `hero.film.magnet-flip.note`: the field leans up, then the lean is reversed: a down domain is born and spreads
- `hero.film.maxwell-demon.label`: Maxwell's demon
- `hero.film.maxwell-demon.note`: a demon lets fast molecules through to the right and slow ones to the left; each choice is a bit in its memory, and erasing a bit costs at least kT ln 2 (Landauer)
- `hero.film.mlrn-belief-tracks.label`: a belief tracks
- `hero.film.mlrn-belief-tracks.note`: a belief follows a hidden cause through noisy observations by gradient descent on free energy; the bars are that free energy before and after
- `hero.film.mlrn-beta-sharpens.label`: attention sharpens
- `hero.film.mlrn-beta-sharpens.note`: a modern Hopfield read, attention's softmax over seven stored patterns: as the inverse temperature rises, the read moves from their average to the nearest
- `hero.film.mlrn-cd-filters.label`: contrastive divergence
- `hero.film.mlrn-cd-filters.note`: a restricted Boltzmann machine learns pictures of bars by contrastive divergence; its eight filters sharpen as its reconstruction error falls
- `hero.film.mlrn-dense-recalls.label`: dense memory
- `hero.film.mlrn-dense-recalls.note`: two memories hold 25 patterns in 100 units, past the 0.138 limit: the classical Hopfield net keeps errors (lower left), the dense one clears them
- `hero.film.mlrn-em-fit.label`: fitting three Gaussians
- `hero.film.mlrn-em-fit.note`: expectation-maximisation fits three Gaussians to 150 points; each step lowers the free energy, minus the log likelihood, traced on the right
- `hero.film.mlrn-energy-falls.label`: the energy falls
- `hero.film.mlrn-energy-falls.note`: a Hopfield net recalls a ring from 30% noise, one unit at a time; beside it its energy -1/2 s.W.s, which never rises
- `hero.film.mlrn-kl-two-ways.label`: KL two ways
- `hero.film.mlrn-kl-two-ways.note`: one Gaussian fitted to two peaks by gradient descent: KL(q||p) settles on one peak (left), KL(p||q) spreads over both (right)
- `hero.film.mlrn-momentum-race.label`: the heavy ball
- `hero.film.mlrn-momentum-race.note`: gradient descent (ring) zigzags down a narrow valley of the loss while the heavy ball, with momentum (disc), reaches the bottom first
- `hero.film.mlrn-soft-cutoff.label`: the soft cut-off
- `hero.film.mlrn-soft-cutoff.note`: our SDM language model's store weighs its 2k best hard locations by sigmoid((s - theta) / softness): hard at small softness, spread wide at large
- `hero.film.mlrn-two-hop.label`: the two-hop read
- `hero.film.mlrn-two-hop.note`: our SDM language model's read in two dimensions: the address wakes the best keys (rings), the read moves it, and the second hop wakes others (squares)
- `hero.film.mphys-crooks-cross.label`: the Crooks crossing
- `hero.film.mphys-crooks-cross.note`: a trap stiffened from 1 to 4 (bars up) and relaxed back (bars down, mirrored): the two work histograms stand equal at the free-energy change, ln 2 (dotted)
- `hero.film.mphys-entropy-production.label`: entropy runs backward
- `hero.film.mphys-entropy-production.note`: entropy given to the bath by a pushed particle over growing windows: the backward share (outlines) shrinks, and ln P(s)/P(-s) = s holds every time (right)
- `hero.film.mphys-erasure-protocol.label`: erasing a bit
- `hero.film.mphys-erasure-protocol.note`: particles in a double well, one bit each: lower the barrier, tilt, raise it, untilt, and nearly all end on the right; the gauge is the mean work, above the dotted kT ln 2
- `hero.film.mphys-fdt-kick.label`: fluctuation and response
- `hero.film.mphys-fdt-kick.note`: a damped oscillator in a heat bath, pushed by a small steady force (squares), moves as its own resting jitter at temperature T predicts, (C(0) - C(t)) / T (line)
- `hero.film.mphys-jarzynski-drag.label`: Jarzynski's equality
- `hero.film.mphys-jarzynski-drag.note`: a trap dragged through a warm fluid, run after run: the work histogram builds up, its mean (ring) above zero, while -ln <e^-W> (tick) lands on the free-energy change, zero
- `hero.film.mphys-langevin-cloud.label`: Langevin meets Fokker-Planck
- `hero.film.mphys-langevin-cloud.note`: 600 particles jiggling in a double well (bars) and the Fokker-Planck density solved beside them (line): one story told twice, from one valley to both
- `hero.film.mphys-lee-yang.label`: Lee-Yang zeros
- `hero.film.mphys-lee-yang.note`: the zeros of the exact partition function of a 4 x 4 Ising torus in the field's fugacity: all on the unit circle, closing in on z = 1 as the temperature falls (bar)
- `hero.film.mphys-rg-zoom.label`: zooming out
- `hero.film.mphys-rg-zoom.note`: three Ising lattices seen through ever larger majority blocks: below Tc they flow to order, above it to noise, and at Tc every zoom looks alike, the fixed point of the renormalisation group
- `hero.film.mphys-scaling-collapse.label`: a scaling collapse
- `hero.film.mphys-scaling-collapse.note`: the magnetisation of Ising lattices of 8, 16 and 32, rescaled by L^(1/8) against (T - Tc) L: three curves slide onto one
- `hero.film.mphys-wolff-clusters.label`: Wolff clusters
- `hero.film.mphys-wolff-clusters.note`: an Ising lattice at Tc updated by Wolff's rule: each frame lights the whole cluster flipped at once, a fractal at the critical point; the move beats critical slowing down
- `hero.film.msdm-binomial-shell.label`: the binomial shell
- `hero.film.msdm-binomial-shell.note`: the share of all words of n bits at each relative Hamming distance from one, n from 1 to 512, each drawn to one height: the shell narrows as 1 / (2 sqrt n), from 0.5 to 0.022
- `hero.film.msdm-circles-part.label`: two circles part
- `hero.film.msdm-circles-part.note`: two access circles of radius 451 in 1,000 bits, drawn so the lens is the exact share of hard-locations they share, as their addresses move apart: from 1 down to 0.22
- `hero.film.msdm-hrr-wheel.label`: circular convolution
- `hero.film.msdm-hrr-wheel.note`: Plate's binding: the circular convolution of two 32-number vectors, one entry at a time; correlating the result with the first gives back the second at similarity 0.82
- `hero.film.msdm-iterated-reads.label`: reads that settle
- `hero.film.msdm-iterated-reads.note`: a real SDM holding 40 words of 256 bits, read again and again from 8 to 128 bits off: starts within 32 bits fall to the word, from 56 on they wander off
- `hero.film.msdm-noise-ruler.label`: a noisy word's ruler
- `hero.film.msdm-noise-ruler.note`: noise flipped on a 10,000-bit word A up to 47.5%: its distance to a word B 2,500 bits away follows Kanerva's d + (1 - 2d)e within 85 bits
- `hero.film.msdm-read-humps.label`: the read sums
- `hero.film.msdm-read-humps.note`: a real SDM written 16 words a frame up to 288: each stored bit read back, its sum signed by its true value, is a hump that widens; the 1.98% left of 0 read wrong
- `hero.film.msdm-resonator.label`: a resonator
- `hero.film.msdm-resonator.note`: a resonator network finds the three factors of one 400-dimensional product among 27,000 combinations by unbinding and cleaning up in turn, all three by step 12
- `hero.film.msdm-sequence-recall.label`: a sequence read back
- `hero.film.msdm-sequence-recall.note`: a sequence of 14 items bundled into one 2,048-bit vector, each item rotated by its place; rotating back and cleaning up reads every place right, 14 of 14
- `hero.film.msdm-walk-to-equator.label`: a walk to the equator
- `hero.film.msdm-walk-to-equator.note`: a random walk on the 1,000-bit cube, one bit flipped a step: in 3,000 steps it drifts out to 500 bits from its start, as 500(1 - (1 - 2/n)^t) says
- `hero.film.msdm-xor-isometry.label`: binding keeps distance
- `hero.film.msdm-xor-isometry.note`: binding by XOR moves every corner of the 4-cube but keeps every distance: two corners 3 bits apart, bound to four keys in turn, stay 3 bits apart
- `hero.film.mset-ask-funnel.label`: ask closes in
- `hero.film.mset-ask-funnel.note`: ten runs of SETTLE's ask, each a running answer as sweeps double: they close on the exact probability 0.228 (dashed), inside the funnel two standard errors wide
- `hero.film.mset-boltzmann-cools.label`: the Boltzmann law cools
- `hero.film.mset-boltzmann-cools.note`: the exact chances e^(-E/T) / Z of the 16 arrangements of a leaning ring of four, on a log scale, as T falls from 6 to 0.25: from nearly even to all on one
- `hero.film.mset-bp-tree.label`: messages on a tree
- `hero.film.mset-bp-tree.note`: belief propagation on a tree of 15 pulled things: messages pass up to the root and back down, and every belief (the fill) ends on the exact probability over all 32,768 arrangements
- `hero.film.mset-counting-z.label`: counting Z
- `hero.film.mset-counting-z.note`: all 256 arrangements of a ring of eight, one thing flipped at a time (a Gray code), each adding its weight: the sum stops at Z = 670.6, as the transfer matrix says
- `hero.film.mset-mean-field-iterate.label`: the mean-field map
- `hero.film.mset-mean-field-iterate.note`: mean field stepped as a cobweb, m to tanh(m / T) at T 0.6: from just above zero it climbs to 0.907, from just below it falls to -0.907, the two settled magnets
- `hero.film.mset-mixing.label`: walkers spreading
- `hero.film.mset-mixing.note`: 400 walkers on the four-cube of a pulled ring, all started all no; Gibbs sweeps (more each frame) spread them until the corners hold their Boltzmann shares, the far corner too
- `hero.film.mset-rao-blackwell.label`: reading softly
- `hero.film.mset-rao-blackwell.note`: one settle of a picture read two ways, sample by sample: the average of the bits (middle) and of tanh(I) (right); after 20 sweeps the soft read is 3 times closer to the answer (left)
- `hero.film.mset-schedules.label`: three cooling schedules
- `hero.film.mset-schedules.note`: one rugged line, three Metropolis walkers: quenched cold it sticks near the start; SETTLE's geometric cooling finds the deepest valley; c / ln(2 + k) is still warm at the end
- `hero.film.mset-tap-pull.label`: leans for a picture
- `hero.film.mset-tap-pull.note`: a target of greys (left) settled with leans atanh(m), mean field and TAP as the pull grows to 0.42: mean field overshoots from a pull of 0.34 and breaks; TAP stays closest
- `hero.film.mset-tsp-anneal.label`: a salesman, annealed
- `hero.film.mset-tsp-anneal.note`: Kirkpatrick's salesman: a tour of 30 cities cooled by the Metropolis rule, path reversals as moves; it shortens from 1,252 to 353 and ends with no two edges crossing
- `hero.film.msnd-binaural-phase.label`: the beat between the ears
- `hero.film.msnd-binaural-phase.note`: two sine waves, 200 Hz in the left ear and 240 Hz in the right, seen every 1.25 ms: the angle between them turns once in 25 ms, a 40 Hz beat made only where the ears meet
- `hero.film.msnd-filter-drop.label`: the filter drop
- `hero.film.msnd-filter-drop.note`: the DJ's filter drop: a low-pass closes from 12 kHz to 250 Hz over a bar, taking a sawtooth wave's harmonics from the top down, then snaps open on the line
- `hero.film.msnd-fourier-build.label`: a square wave from sines
- `hero.film.msnd-fourier-build.note`: a square wave summed from its odd harmonics, one more sine each frame: the sum closes in on the square, but its overshoot at each jump stays near 9%
- `hero.film.msnd-master-phase.label`: the master beat's strobe
- `hero.film.msnd-master-phase.note`: three beats seen once per 500 ms master tick, as every settle and sound here keeps time: 40 Hz and 10 Hz land on phase zero each tick, 7.83 Hz drifts 0.085 of a turn
- `hero.film.msnd-plucked-string.label`: a plucked string
- `hero.film.msnd-plucked-string.note`: Karplus-Strong: random noise loops through a 100-sample delay, each pass averaging neighbours: the high harmonics die first and a pitched tone settles out of the noise
- `hero.film.msnd-resonance-sweep.label`: resonance
- `hero.film.msnd-resonance-sweep.note`: a spring and mass driven at a rising frequency, as a filter's resonance is: its swing and the energy it holds peak near its own frequency, as the formula says
- `hero.film.msnd-surprisal-scroll.label`: surprise, letter by letter
- `hero.film.msnd-surprisal-scroll.note`: a sentence read by a small letter model: each bar is its surprise, -log2 p of the letter given the two before, in bits; the expected letters cost almost nothing
- `hero.film.msnd-temperature-sweep.label`: the temperature of a token
- `hero.film.msnd-temperature-sweep.note`: a letter model's softmax for the letter after "the " as its temperature rises from 0.15 to 6: one letter wins when cold, all spread when hot; the needle is the entropy in bits
- `hero.film.msnd-third-lissajous.label`: a just and a tempered third
- `hero.film.msnd-third-lissajous.note`: two sine waves a major third apart: tuned just, 5 to 4, their figure stands still; tuned equal, 2^(4/12), 13.69 cents wider, it drifts 3.97 times a second
- `hero.film.msnd-winding.label`: the Fourier transform
- `hero.film.msnd-winding.note`: a wave of 3 Hz and 5 Hz wound round a circle at 1 to 7 turns a second: its centre of mass leaves the middle only at 3 and 5, the frequencies it holds
- `hero.film.nonogram.label`: a nonogram solving
- `hero.film.nonogram.note`: each line placed by logic alone: a cell is filled or ruled out only when every way the clues fit agrees
- `hero.film.pbit-flicker.label`: one p-bit
- `hero.film.pbit-flicker.note`: one p-bit tosses its coin 20 times a frame while its lean slides from no to yes; its share of yes follows (1 + tanh(I / T)) / 2
- `hero.film.phase-transition.label`: a phase transition
- `hero.film.phase-transition.note`: an Ising field cooled from T 3.5 to T 1: its order |m| stays near zero, then rises below the critical temperature 2.27
- `hero.film.purkinje-grow.label`: a Purkinje cell growing
- `hero.film.purkinje-grow.note`: its dendrites spread as one flat fan
- `hero.film.rann-bridge-anneals.label`: a bridge settles
- `hero.film.rann-bridge-anneals.note`: an arch bridge kept only in how 196 neighbouring spins agree or differ, annealed out of noise: the middle panel cools, its overlap with the bridge climbing from 0.06 to 1.00
- `hero.film.rhop-hands-settle.label`: hands held again
- `hero.film.rhop-hands-settle.note`: a Hopfield net of 256 units storing two figures holding hands, a sun and a sprout: given the figures with 80 bits flipped, one sweep sets all 80 back and the hands meet again
- `hero.film.rsdm-votes-gather.label`: votes gather
- `hero.film.rsdm-votes-gather.note`: a circle of eight friends read from a blurred copy, 24 of its 144 bits wrong: the middle panel is the SDM's running vote as 241 woken hard-locations add in; from 82 on it is the circle
- `hero.film.rset-mark-settles.label`: the mark settles
- `hero.film.rset-mark-settles.note`: SETTLE's star as 210 p-bits, its own pixels scrambled; one sweep a frame while the temperature falls from 6 to 0.6, from 106 pixels wrong to none
- `hero.film.rwld-shoal-turns.label`: a shoal turns as one
- `hero.film.rwld-shoal-turns.note`: a Vicsek flock of 9 fish, each turning toward its neighbours' mean heading, with a noise that cools: their order rises from 0.21 to 1.00 and they swim as one
- `hero.film.sdm-heal.label`: a vote heals a letter
- `hero.film.sdm-heal.note`: a noisy A read from a real SDM of six letters comes back clean
- `hero.film.sdm-read.label`: a read
- `hero.film.sdm-read.note`: a real SDM: the woken hard locations vote on every bit, and the sign is the answer
- `hero.film.sdm-roundtrip.label`: a write, then a read
- `hero.film.sdm-roundtrip.note`: an SDM writes an S at one address and is read 12 bits away: the hard locations both woke carry the word back
- `hero.film.sdm-wake.label`: a read waking hard locations
- `hero.film.sdm-wake.note`: a read-address walks from one address to another; the hard locations inside its activation radius wake and go back to sleep
- `hero.film.sdm-write.label`: a write
- `hero.film.sdm-write.note`: the address wakes the hard locations inside its activation radius; each adds the word to its bit-counters
- `hero.film.separate.label`: a mixture separates
- `hero.film.separate.note`: half the spins up and half down, and only swaps of unlike neighbours allowed: the count is kept while the two kinds gather into domains
- `hero.film.softness.label`: a softness dial
- `hero.film.softness.note`: the tanh rule and a field at the same temperature, T 0.3 to 3 and back
- `hero.film.spike-train.label`: a spike train
- `hero.film.spike-train.note`: six leaky integrate-and-fire neurons: a stronger input fires them faster, and the one below threshold never fires
- `hero.film.spin-glass.label`: a spin glass freezes
- `hero.film.spin-glass.note`: cooled side by side: a magnet (left) orders into domains, and a spin glass with bonds of random sign (right) freezes with no order
- `hero.film.sudoku-fill.label`: a sudoku filling
- `hero.film.sudoku-fill.note`: every digit is placed only when it is the one digit its row, column and box allow
- `hero.film.sudoku.label`: a sudoku settling
- `hero.film.sudoku.note`: row swaps under the Metropolis rule while the temperature falls
- `hero.film.token-vote.label`: a next token by vote
- `hero.film.token-vote.note`: an SDM that read one sentence picks each next letter: the hard locations its last three letters wake vote, and the top letter is written
- `hero.film.wave.label`: two waves
- `hero.film.wave.note`: two sources ripple the same pond: where crest meets trough the water stays still
- `hero.gamma.dark`: dark {pct}% of the time
- `hero.gamma.darkmeasuring`: measuring the dark share
- `hero.gamma.flicker.beat`: flicker {shown} · {dark} · {refresh} Hz display{lock}
- `hero.gamma.lock`:  · on the master beat within {ms} ms
- `hero.gamma.lock.plain`:  · on the master beat
- `hero.gamma.measuring`: measuring
- `hero.gamma.measuringdisplay`: measuring the display...
- `hero.gamma.nearest`: Your display draws {refresh} frames a second, so the light flickers at {hz} Hz, not {asked}: the nearest rate it can draw exactly. The sound plays at exactly 40 Hz. ({parts})
- `hero.gamma.refused`: Light not shown: {why}. The sound still plays at 40 Hz.
- `hero.gamma.short.nearest`: ON, {hz} Hz ({refresh} Hz screen)
- `hero.gamma.short.notshown`: not shown
- `hero.gamma.short.off`: OFF
- `hero.gamma.short.on`: ON, {hz} Hz
- `hero.gamma.short.starting`: starting
- `hero.gamma.shown`: {hz} Hz shown
- `hero.gamma.warnfirst`: Flashing light: a warning comes first.
- `hero.glyph.adjust`: adjust
- `hero.glyph.bar`: back to the bar
- `hero.glyph.expand`: expand
- `hero.glyph.flute`: sound and 40 Hz light
- `hero.glyph.flute.on`: sound and 40 Hz light · light on
- `hero.glyph.picture.paused`: picture · paused
- `hero.glyph.picture.playing`: picture · playing
- `hero.glyph.pin`: pin · keep the hero live on every page
- `hero.glyph.pinned`: pinned · the hero stays live on every page
- `hero.glyph.plato-annealing.label`: ANNEALING
- `hero.glyph.plato-annealing.note`: the word ANNEALING kept as a SETTLE memory of 45 things, settled from a copy with 11 bits wrong and drawn on a dodecahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell ANNEALING, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-binding.label`: BINDING
- `hero.glyph.plato-binding.note`: the word BINDING kept as a SETTLE memory of 35 things, settled from a copy with 9 bits wrong and drawn on an octahedron; 34 of 35 came back, so the lit parts read BILDING
- `hero.glyph.plato-boltzmann.label`: BOLTZMANN
- `hero.glyph.plato-boltzmann.note`: the word BOLTZMANN kept as a SETTLE memory of 45 things, settled from a copy with 11 bits wrong and drawn on an icosahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell BOLTZMANN, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-entropy.label`: ENTROPY
- `hero.glyph.plato-entropy.note`: the word ENTROPY kept as a SETTLE memory of 35 things, settled from a copy with 9 bits wrong and drawn on a cube; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell ENTROPY, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-free-energy.label`: FREE ENERGY
- `hero.glyph.plato-free-energy.note`: the word FREE ENERGY kept as a SETTLE memory of 55 things, settled from a copy with 14 bits wrong and drawn on an icosahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell FREE ENERGY, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-gibbs.label`: GIBBS
- `hero.glyph.plato-gibbs.note`: the word GIBBS kept as a SETTLE memory of 25 things, settled from a copy with 6 bits wrong and drawn on an octahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell GIBBS, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-hamming.label`: HAMMING
- `hero.glyph.plato-hamming.note`: the word HAMMING kept as a SETTLE memory of 35 things, settled from a copy with 9 bits wrong and drawn on a cube; 32 of 35 came back, so the lit parts read HAMMIVE
- `hero.glyph.plato-hopfield.label`: HOPFIELD
- `hero.glyph.plato-hopfield.note`: the word HOPFIELD kept as a SETTLE memory of 40 things, settled from a copy with 10 bits wrong and drawn on a dodecahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell HOPFIELD, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-hypervector.label`: HYPERVECTOR
- `hero.glyph.plato-hypervector.note`: the word HYPERVECTOR kept as a SETTLE memory of 55 things, settled from a copy with 14 bits wrong and drawn on an icosahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell HYPERVECTOR, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-ising.label`: ISING
- `hero.glyph.plato-ising.note`: the word ISING kept as a SETTLE memory of 25 things, settled from a copy with 6 bits wrong and drawn on two nested tetrahedra; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell ISING, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-kanerva.label`: KANERVA
- `hero.glyph.plato-kanerva.note`: the word KANERVA kept as a SETTLE memory of 35 things, settled from a copy with 9 bits wrong and drawn on a dodecahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell KANERVA, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-landauer.label`: LANDAUER
- `hero.glyph.plato-landauer.note`: the word LANDAUER kept as a SETTLE memory of 40 things, settled from a copy with 10 bits wrong and drawn on an icosahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell LANDAUER, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-memory.label`: MEMORY
- `hero.glyph.plato-memory.note`: the word MEMORY kept as a SETTLE memory of 30 things, settled from a copy with 8 bits wrong and drawn on a cube; 27 of 30 came back, so the lit parts read ?EMKVY
- `hero.glyph.plato-p-bit.label`: P-BIT
- `hero.glyph.plato-p-bit.note`: the word P-BIT kept as a SETTLE memory of 25 things, settled from a copy with 6 bits wrong and drawn on two nested tetrahedra; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell P-BIT, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-settle.label`: SETTLE
- `hero.glyph.plato-settle.note`: the word SETTLE kept as a SETTLE memory of 30 things, settled from a copy with 8 bits wrong and drawn on an icosahedron; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell SETTLE, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.plato-spin.label`: SPIN
- `hero.glyph.plato-spin.note`: the word SPIN kept as a SETTLE memory of 20 things, settled from a copy with 5 bits wrong and drawn on two nested tetrahedra; every bold edge and filled point is a yes, and read in order they spell SPIN, five to a letter
- `hero.glyph.sound.muted`: sound · muted by MUTE ALL (top right)
- `hero.glyph.sound.off`: sound · off
- `hero.glyph.sound.on`: sound · on
- `hero.glyph.stop`: stop the 40 Hz light
- `hero.light.about`: about the 40 Hz light
- `hero.light.hint`: The light changes nothing about the sound.
- `hero.light.reduced`: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the 40 Hz light stays off.
- `hero.light.sitewide`: One mode for the whole site: every settling picture flickers together, the footer included. The bright 40 Hz OFF at the top right, or Escape, ends it.
- `hero.light.turnoff`: turn the 40 Hz light off
- `hero.light.turnon`: turn the 40 Hz light on
- `hero.liveeq.live-actprob.label`: the activation-probability, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-actprob.note`: the activation-radius H sweeps from 400 to 500 bits of 1,000; the share of addresses within H is computed exactly at each step
- `hero.liveeq.live-anneal.label`: annealing, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-anneal.note`: a 24 by 14 Ising lattice cooled from T 3.5 to 0.8 by Gibbs sweeps; its energy E is computed every sweep and falls
- `hero.liveeq.live-boltzmann.label`: two levels cooling, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-boltzmann.note`: two states with energies 0 and 1; as T falls, the Boltzmann weights move to the lower one
- `hero.liveeq.live-hdc.label`: the dollar of Mexico, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-hdc.note`: two country records bundled from role-filler XORs; the dollar is unbound into the peso, and noise rises while the clean-up still names it
- `hero.liveeq.live-metropolis.label`: the Metropolis rule, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-metropolis.note`: a walker proposes a step left or right and accepts it with probability min(1, e^(-ΔE/T)); the running acceptance rate is counted
- `hero.liveeq.live-pbit.label`: the tanh rule, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-pbit.note`: the lean I sweeps from −3 to 3; the chance of yes is computed as it moves
- `hero.liveeq.live-softmax.label`: softmax and temperature, live
- `hero.liveeq.live-softmax.note`: five fixed scores; as T rises the probabilities flatten, as it falls the top score takes almost all
- `hero.look.clear`: CLEAR
- `hero.look.sparkle`: SPARKLE
- `hero.look.weather`: WEATHER
- `hero.math.access-overlap.label`: two access circles
- `hero.math.access-overlap.note`: two access circles of an SDM and the share of hard-locations they share as their centres move apart
- `hero.math.annealing-walker.label`: an annealed walker
- `hero.math.annealing-walker.note`: a Metropolis walker on a rugged landscape (below) as it cools: time runs downward, the wandering narrows to the deepest valley
- `hero.math.binary-entropy.label`: the entropy of a bit
- `hero.math.binary-entropy.note`: a bit's entropy: none when certain, one full bit at a fair coin
- `hero.math.boltzmann-bars.label`: the Boltzmann weights
- `hero.math.boltzmann-bars.note`: the probability of twelve evenly spaced energy levels, cold (filled) and warm (outlined)
- `hero.math.boltzmann-learning.label`: the two phases
- `hero.math.boltzmann-learning.note`: Boltzmann machine learning: the network clamped to data and the same network running free; the weights move by the difference
- `hero.math.bundle-similarity.label`: a bundle remembers
- `hero.math.bundle-similarity.note`: how like each member a majority bundle of k random hypervectors stays, against the noise floor of 10,000-bit hypervectors
- `hero.math.chain-correlation.label`: spin chain correlations
- `hero.math.chain-correlation.note`: how far a spin in a one-dimensional Ising chain is felt, at three temperatures
- `hero.math.contrastive-divergence.label`: contrastive divergence
- `hero.math.contrastive-divergence.note`: a Gibbs chain alternating visible and hidden layers; contrastive divergence stops it after one step
- `hero.math.correlation-length.label`: the correlation length
- `hero.math.correlation-length.note`: how far a spin feels its neighbours in the 2D Ising model: the reach grows without bound at the critical point
- `hero.math.critical-slowing.label`: critical slowing down
- `hero.math.critical-slowing.note`: how fast the memory of a state fades at five temperatures nearing the critical point: slower and slower
- `hero.math.curie-weiss.label`: the mean-field magnet
- `hero.math.curie-weiss.note`: the mean-field equation solved by eye: m = tanh(beta m) crosses the line m three times once beta passes one
- `hero.math.detailed-balance.label`: detailed balance
- `hero.math.detailed-balance.note`: four states, their Boltzmann weights as dot sizes, and the probability flowing each way along every link: equal in both directions
- `hero.math.entropy-simplex.label`: entropy on a triangle
- `hero.math.entropy-simplex.note`: every distribution over three states is a point of the triangle; the contours are its entropy, highest at the centre
- `hero.math.gibbs-samples.label`: Boltzmann samples
- `hero.math.gibbs-samples.note`: exact samples from a Boltzmann distribution over a double well, over its energy contours
- `hero.math.glauber-rate.label`: the Glauber rate
- `hero.math.glauber-rate.note`: Glauber's heat-bath flip rate at three temperatures, with Metropolis dashed
- `hero.math.hamming-ball.label`: a Hamming ball
- `hero.math.hamming-ball.note`: the share of all 1,000-bit words within distance r, on a log scale: radius 451 holds about one in a thousand
- `hero.math.hamming-binomial.label`: distances in 1,000 bits
- `hero.math.hamming-binomial.note`: the distance between two random 1,000-bit words: almost always within a few dozen of 500; the dashed line is the activation-radius 451
- `hero.math.hopfield-basins.label`: Hopfield basins
- `hero.math.hopfield-basins.note`: the basins of attraction of a dense associative memory storing five patterns, with paths that fall into them
- `hero.math.hopfield-capacity.label`: Hopfield capacity
- `hero.math.hopfield-capacity.note`: a Hopfield net's recall against how many patterns it holds per neuron, zoomed near 1: it fails suddenly near 0.138; dashed is the overlap after one step
- `hero.math.hysteresis-loop.label`: hysteresis
- `hero.math.hysteresis-loop.note`: a mean-field magnet swept by a field: the stable branches, the unstable middle, and the jumps where a branch ends
- `hero.math.kramers-escape.label`: escape over a barrier
- `hero.math.kramers-escape.note`: a particle in a well must climb the barrier to escape; Kramers' rate falls on a straight line against 1/T
- `hero.math.landau-tilted-well.label`: a tilted double well
- `hero.math.landau-tilted-well.note`: the Landau free energy of a magnet below its critical point, tilted by a growing field; the ball rests in the deeper valley
- `hero.math.landauer-erasure.label`: erasing one bit
- `hero.math.landauer-erasure.note`: Landauer's erasure: a particle in either half, the wall removed and a piston pushed in, the particle on the left; it costs at least kT ln 2 of heat
- `hero.math.langevin-path.label`: a Langevin path
- `hero.math.langevin-path.note`: one overdamped Langevin path in a double-well energy at temperature 0.28: it rattles in one valley and now and then crosses to the other
- `hero.math.log-partition.label`: the log partition function
